options.doc:

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.doc:

This seed can be any value; any value which is not an integer is hashed to produce an integer.
Set to 0 to use a random seed.

options.name: Region Whitelist
options.doc:
Which regions to consider/enable for randomization.
Regions are sorted hierarchically. The root region is the 'All Expeditions' region; its children are the
expeditions regions, ie 'R1A1'; its children are its layers, such as 'R1A1 (Main)' or 'R1A1 (Dim #1)';
its children are zones, objectives, and so forth.
Whitelisting or blacklisting a region applies the same to all its children.
This set is a whitelist; for a region to be randomized it must match the whitelist and not the blacklist.

options.name: GTFO Start Inventory
options.doc:
During randomization, a set of all unique reachable items is created. This includes both
randomized items and non-randomized items. For each `tag: count` in this option, `count`
items which are children of `tag` are selected and duplicated, creating a copy which is
added to the starting inventory. If no matches are found, `tag` is assumed to be an item
and is created by name, adding `count` duplicates of it to the starting inventory.

If no matches are found, tag is assumed to be an item and is created by name, adding count duplicates of it to the starting inventory.

Pour chaque `tag: count` de cette option, les éléments `count` qui sont des enfants de `tag` sont sélectionnés et dupliqués, créant une copie qui est ajoutée à l'inventaire de départ. Si aucune correspondance n'est trouvée, `tag` est supposé être un élément et est créé par son nom, en ajoutant des duplicatas `count` à l'inventaire de départ.

options.name: Start Vouchers
options.doc:
Start vouchers, specified as a list of tags. During randomization, one
item per requested voucher will be removed from the item pool and placed
in the starting inventory. If you use a tag which is a parent of multiple
items, one random applicable item is selected per request. If duplicate
items exist in the item pool, they are equally likely to be selected, but
no more than the quantity of items in the pool can be selected.

This differs from Start Inventory in that it will never create new items,
it can only move randomized items out of the pool and into the starting inventory.

options.name: Early Items
options.doc:
Items matching tags in this list will be added to the first sphere.
If a parent tag is specified, the requested quantity of children will be randomly
selected from the random items pool for randomization.
For example, if using the 'ITEM' progressive style, you may specify `"Expedition Unlock Items": 1`
to choose one random available expedition unlock to be an early item.
This will only work on items which both exist and are randomized.
The special value "-1" will randomize all matching child tags.

La valeur spéciale "-1" va randomiser toutes les étiquettes enfant correspondantes.

Select one or more expeditions to enable. These will be the expeditions you must
clear. Optionally, choose "All Expeditions" to enable everything (including
normally hidden expeditions, at your own risk)

You may either provide a list of values or a mapping of `name: weight` pairs.
If using a mapping, you may choose how many options to select using the special value
'random'. For example, `random: 3` selects 3 options. `random: 2-5` selects 2 to 5 options.
`random: -1` will select all values with a weight greater than 0.

options.name: Progression Style
options.doc:
Controls how expeditions are unlocked.
FREE         - All expeditions start unlocked.
ITEM         - You must obtain an item to unlock an expedition.
PROGRESSIVE  - Each main sector cleared unlocks a new expedition.
FULLPROG     - Each full clear unlocks a new expedition.
               This means PE, secondary and overload are required.
DUAL         - Enables both ITEM and PROGRESSIVE styles.
FULLDUAL     - Enables both ITEM and FULLPROG styles.
SEMIPROG     - Both ITEM and PROGRESSIVE. Archipelago will ignore
               ITEM paths during randomization.
SEMIFULLPROG - Both ITEM and FULLPROG. Archipelago will ignore
               ITEM paths during randomization.

POINT - Vous devez obtenir un article pour débloquer une expédition.
PROGRESSIVE - Chaque secteur principal débloque une nouvelle expédition.

               Cela signifie que PE, secondaire et surcharge sont nécessaires.
DUAL - Active les styles ITEM et PROGRESSIVE.

SEMIPROG - POINT ET PROGRESSIVE. L'archipel ignorera les chemins ITEM pendant la randomisation.

options.doc:

options.name: Progressive Ordering
options.doc:
Only applicable in any variant of PROGRESSIVE mode. What order should expeditions
be completed in?

RundownTierIndex  - Complete all expeditions in order, starting with R1A1.
RundownTierRandom - Similar to above, but expeditions in a tier are shuffled.
RundownRandom     - Similar to above, but expedition in a rundown are shuffled.
TierIndexRundown  - First clear all A1, then all A2, etc
TierIndexRandom   - Same as above, but expeditions in a tier are randomized.
TierRandom        - Must clear all A, then all B, etc in random order.
FullRandom        - The expeditions are in a completely randomized order.
options.doc_html:

RundownRandom - Similar to above, but expedition in a rundown are shuffled. TierIndexRundown - First clear all A1, then all A2, etc TierIndexRandom - Same as above, but expeditions in a tier are randomized. TierRandom - Must clear all A, then all B, etc in random order. FullRandom - The expeditions are in a completely randomized order.

RundownTierIndex - Effectuez toutes les expéditions en ordre, en commençant par R1A1.
RunddownTierRandom - Comme ci-dessus, mais les expéditions dans un niveau sont serrées.
RundownRandom - Comme ci-dessus, mais l'expédition dans un rundown est secouée.
TierIndexRundown - Tout d'abord effacer tout A1, puis tout A2, etc
TierIndexRandom - Même que ci-dessus, mais les expéditions dans un niveau sont randomisées.
TierRandom - Doit effacer tous A, puis tous B, etc dans l'ordre aléatoire.
FullRandom - Les expéditions sont complètement randomisées.

options.name: Empty Location Randomization
options.doc:
Customize the randomization of all supported empty locations.
One empty location is added for each "floating" item that gets randomized to
maintain the item:location balance required by Archipelago.
Enabling randomization of an empty location makes it available as a candidate
for a floating item.
Whitelist: Enables for all unless blacklisted elsewhere.
Blacklist: Disables for all.
None: Defer to other relevant setting(s). If no other relevant setting is set,
defaults to blacklisted.
